manufacture.sequence: decorative vertical grooves preceded carving of the fifteen inscription signs in the mould
manufacture.evidence: fourth sign of central column crosses/overlies vertical groove

prior_condition: natural patina damaged by past acid treatment

inscription_observations.overdot_locations: above first signs of each column; third visible conditionally and in older photograph
inscription_observations.direction_hypothesis: top-down reading proposed by Flouda, not project-adjudicated
inscription_observations.repeat_observation: third sign of middle column confirmed same as fourth sign of first/left column despite corrosion

classification.script_assignment: cannot be indisputably assigned to Cretan Hieroglyphic or Linear A

guardrails: Overdots are recorded as physical marks; Flouda's proposed directional function remains interpretive.
Formal similarities to Phaistos/Linear A do not establish identity or phonetic value.
Two 'unique' signs is an authority claim pending sign-by-sign concordance.
